name: Dera Baba Nanak–Narowal National Highway
significance: NH 354B is a branch of NH 354. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Dera Baba Nanak to Narowal, and it meets NH 354 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 354 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Malout to Gurdaspur
